fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD) Q3 2026 revenue of $13.4B grew 45% year-over-year, with Data Center segment surging 97% to $8.5B, though stock has fallen over 30% from 52-week high of $658.
